Two yellow-bellied marmots mysteriously turned up in San Francisco and Antioch after apparently hitching rides in vehicle engine compartments from the Sierra Nevada or Burning Man.

The Bright Side:
Alert citizens and dedicated urban wildlife rescuers ensure these misplaced alpine rodents are safely intercepted and cared for.
